findings.summary: compiler.ts inlined the exact integer-based double-literal rule that cpp-literals.ts documents as broken (String(1e21) is "1e+21", so it emitted 1e+21.0), on the very path this change gives static numbers to; it now calls the shared doubleLiteral
compileNumber's property-access arm kept a double-precision static pre-guard that castNumber now performs identically, so the width rule read as if it lived in two places
castNumber was private and two data-lowering sites re-implemented it; it is exposed through the compiler facade beside vec3FromRecord and both delegate

"does this pool carry colours" was transcribed five times across both PALs, where the variant key and the four binding sites must agree or a pipeline declares a stream no draw binds; one pinned_record_instance_colored predicate now answers all five

instance_parent_draw_world restated both arms of draw_world instead of calling it, making "which frame a draw is in" two answers; only the base differs, so it now selects the base and defers the frame — and a record with no pool takes build_instance_parent_world's own early return rather than paying a TRS compose the shader never reads

the pin's own vertex-stream layout (ti-matrix at stride 64, ti-color at 16, both instance-stepped) was typed out in both PALs; one vertex_streams table beside GpuVertex now states the slot, stride and step rate and each backend fills its own descriptor from it

the three Dawn encode sites each copy-pasted the same nested instancing/instance-colour ladder; one instance_streams_for helper holds both preprocessor guards, the way frame_floating_origin_offset already does
encode_variant_draw bound its vertex streams at literal slot numbers 0/1/2 that only SDL derived from the shared enum; both backends now resolve them through vertex_stream_slot
the SDL composed-variant draw issued a separate SDL_BindGPUVertexBuffers per slot, up to three per draw, where the file's own bind_mesh_vertex_buffers already shows the contiguous single-call shape

standardInstanceColorSlot fingerprinted the whole pinned module for an inline BC slot and then re-checked a shape its own predicate had already required; it is now anchored inside rebuildSingle, finds the slot object through its parent property, and the unreachable second refusal is gone
the f32array/u16array/u32array kind triple was written five times across data-lowering and native-functions; one isTypedArrayType predicate in data-types.ts replaces them

laneValue's comment gave a principle instead of its real constraint — a general fold also folds conditions over an unrolled loop index, which moves four sprite scenes — so the measured reason is recorded and two tests in compiler.test.ts pin both halves of the boundary
a comment describing the deleted thin-instance attribute vector was left annotating the vertex stream's reserve call
mesh-options.ts holds a fourth copy of the static-lane width rule
findings.blockedBy: its runtime arm deliberately differs — it emits an explicit static_cast<double> so a scene computing a sphere option in a float expression is visible rather than silently narrowed, where castNumber returns the expression bare. Delegating would drop that cast and move generated bytes for every sphere, ground and torus option with no correctness gain.
findings.filedIn: the comment at src/compiler/intrinsics/mesh-options.ts now names castNumber's rule and states the one addition it makes

findings.summary: the vertex-stream layout is stated once but still not DERIVED: createThinInstanceFragment declares _bufferGroup/_arrayStride/_stepMode/_offset and the generated attribute table drops that half
findings.blockedBy: widening the generated attribute row and rebuilding both backends' buffer lists from data is its own change with its own neutrality proof

findings.summary: a thin-instanced Standard draw now composes its parent world twice per frame — once in the write phase, once in standard_draw_world — where before the eye-relative wiring the two produced different values
findings.blockedBy: removing it means caching the matrix on each backend's mesh record, which is state whose invalidation nothing measures; the corpus has one such mesh (scene 204)

findings.summary: standardInstanceColorSlot lifts the pin's slot TEXT but restates the shape around it (the hasInstanceColor fork, the spread-and-replace, the slot name), which is the half the repo's own rule says must not drift
findings.blockedBy: reading it instead through importPinnedModuleObserving needs rebuildSingle driven against a recording device — a scene, a mesh and a device — which is the same Standard-family harness the node ESM caster view is blocked on
